FastSME API token.description: Operational reads and all writes require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Synthetic clinical and aggregate reads are public.

info.description:
Typed integration access across FastClinic's synthetic clinical model, scheduling, activation, consent, billing, and analytics.

**Access model:** synthetic clinical and aggregate reads are public. Operational reads and every mutation require a bearer token. Those operations remain disabled until the deployment configures `FASTSME_API_TOKEN`.
info.title: FastClinic API

get.description: Synthetic consultation activity and revenue. Derived/imported records are read-only.
Synthetic diagnosis records linked to consultations. Imported clinical facts are read-only.
Synthetic clinical notes. Writes use dedicated validation and archive rather than hard delete.
Contactable or billable parties, separated from subjects of care for guardianship, consent, and payer attribution.

post.description: Implemented for token-authenticated integrations. Production writes remain disabled until FASTSME_API_TOKEN is configured.
